chapter_outcomes: Use metric units of mass, length, area, volume and capacity in practical situations and convert quantities into larger or smaller units
Carry out calculations involving the perimeter and area of a rectangle, triangle, parallelogram and trapezium
Carry out calculations involving the circumference and area of a circle
Carry out calculations involving arc length and sector area as fractions of the circumference and area of a circle, where the sector angle is a factor of 360°
Carry out calculations and solve problems involving the surface area and volume of a: cuboid, prism, cylinder, sphere, pyramid, cone
Carry out calculations and solve problems involving perimeters and areas of: compound shapes, parts of shapes
Carry out calculations and solve problems involving surface areas and volumes of: compound solids, parts of solids
